name: Spells vs Large Creatures Critical Strike Table

notes.columns: Spells against Large Creatures: Normal attack spell vs Slaying attack spell.

rollMatchPolicy: rollMin / rollMax inclusive. Spell attacks vs large creatures can exceed 100; bands run to 251+ and rolls above the top band clamp to it.

normal.text: Your karma is not strong enough to damage such a beast.

slaying.text: Sparks fly. The enchantment fails. You had hoped for more damage.

normal.text: It looked powerful but your foe did not even stumble.

slaying.text: Foe throws off the magic that threatens his very existence.

normal.text: You are daunted by the beast's gaze and your aim fails.

slaying.text: Strike lands solid. Foe howls out in pain and anger!

normal.text: The strike is powerful, but poorly placed. Remember, focus.

slaying.text: Chest strike leaves visible damage. Foe makes a futile attempt to brush it off.

normal.text: The attack lands well but seems only to scuff your foe's skin.

slaying.text: Firm strike to foe's lower abdomen. Measurable damage has been done.
Your assault entangles foe's arm for an instant. Arm is bruised.

normal.text: Weak attack to a vulnerable spot. Foe is enraged by the close call.

slaying.text: Blow to foe's back. Foe's hide is tough, but much damage is done.

normal.text: Blast drives into foe's mouth. The concussion knocks him down and puts him into a coma for a month.

slaying.text: Assaulting foe's very living essence, your strike lands upon his head. His life is stripped from him. He dies instantly.

normal.text: Solid strike on foe's leg. Foe feels the assault.

slaying.text: Attack hammers foe in his shield side. He is in much pain.

normal.text: Solid strike to foe's head hurts him, but he is still coming. If foe has head gear it is knocked off.

slaying.text: Etch a nasty wound in foe's chest over his vitals. He is upset greatly. You have initiative for 6 rounds.

normal.text: Strong blast staggers your terrible foe. He is as surprised as you are at this success. He loses 6 rounds of initiative.

slaying.text: Blow to foe's arm joint lands poorly. Foe will have a bruise. You think you know what went wrong.

normal.text: Hard and effective, your strike almost brings foe down. He stumbles, but does not fall.

slaying.text: You concentrate the energy of the strike and fracture foe's leg bone.

normal.text: Strike lands and tears down into foe's neck. This vicious blast crushes foe's neck and shatters his spine. He falls unmoving and dies in 3 rounds.

slaying.text: You are a mighty enchanter. Your strike hits foe's chest and neck. His neck is broken. Foe drops and dies.

normal.text: You step into the right spot and rip open foe's side. Your blow shatters some ribs. Foe dies in 6 painful rounds.

slaying.text: Perfect aim. Foe's carotid artery and jugular vein are torn open. Foe drops and dies in 3 rounds.

normal.text: Glancing strike to foe's abdomen loses much of the impact on foe's hide.

slaying.text: Side strike. Attack careens down foe's chest and leg. Skin is torn away. Foe roars his defiance.

normal.text: Your weapon wounds deep and cuts muscles and tendons.

slaying.text: Fracture a bone in foe's forearm. It twists in a painful direction. His guard is down.

normal.text: Foe presents a weak spot and you strike. Blow lands at the base of the neck. Tendons are damaged.

slaying.text: He is knocked down and out. Ribs are shattered. The concussion causes internal bleeding.

normal.text: When your strike lands on foe's back, bones crackle and pop. Foe is paralyzed and in a 3 month coma.

slaying.text: Assault causes mortal damage. Foe's organs fail. He is inactive and dies after 3 rounds.

normal.text: Foe lowers his eyes within your reach and you strike with great skill and fury. Foe dies instantly.

slaying.text: Impact of blast drives content of skull in all directions. Foe falls and flails around violently. He dies instantly.
